annotations.title: Send a message to a found person

description: Send one message to a found person from the connected Gmail or Outlook inbox of whoever approved this connection, once the person has approved its exact subject and text: it reaches a real person in their name. Use the draft from draft_prospect_message or the person's own words. LinkJolt adds the lines under it (where they were found, the business's name and postal address, an unsubscribe link, the privacy note) and, when followUpBody is given, sends that follow-up 4 days later in the same thread unless they answer; replies come back to Find affiliates (list_prospect_replies). Refused, with the reason, when the email is not revealed or not verified, they said no or unsubscribed, the address bounced, they joined, the page they were found on is gone, the campaign is not one of the brand's active ones, no inbox is connected (connect it on the Find affiliates page), the business has no postal address yet (added under Business in Settings), or the day's sending limit is used up (50 a day per brand; 20 a day in an inbox's first 7 days of sending). Someone already written to is refused unless writeAgain is true. Requires Pro plan or higher.

body.description: The message, as the person approved it, without the lines LinkJolt adds under it

campaignId.description: The campaign the message invites them to (from the draft's campaigns)

followUpBody.description: The follow-up for 4 days later if they do not answer, as approved; leave it out to send none

prospectId.description: The person, with their email revealed and verified

subject.description: The subject line, as the person approved it

writeAgain.description: true only when the person asked to write again to someone already written to (default false)
